pipeline.name: Discover
pipeline.action: Search/fetch relevant official, legislative and reputable-news sources.

pipeline.name: Normalize
pipeline.action: Convert source records to a common document contract.

pipeline.name: Map
pipeline.action: Map AC, district, Lok Sabha, party and candidate only when deterministic.

pipeline.name: Validate
pipeline.action: Reject malformed records; preserve unknown mappings as null.

pipeline.name: Deduplicate
pipeline.action: Use canonical URL/title/date fingerprints; never duplicate source claims.

pipeline.name: Rank
pipeline.action: Prefer tier 1 sources, then corroborated tier 2, then reference material.

pipeline.name: Retrieve
pipeline.action: Build a small context pack for each user query instead of sending the entire corpus to the model.

pipeline.name: Generate
pipeline.action: Answer only from retrieved evidence and canonical local context; expose gaps.

pipeline.name: Audit
pipeline.action: Return retrieval trace, source timestamps and connector/provider status.

freshness_policy.election_history: canonical local dataset is authoritative until superseded by verified official correction
freshness_policy.booth_data: use packaged verified Form20 dataset; do not overwrite with web content
